blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 48 in June to 45 in September (−6.2%), and it took 6.2% of the city’s 240 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 42 in June to 39 in September (−7.1%), and it took 7.2% of the city’s 375 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Morgan Creek for detached houses in June, July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July, September (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Morgan Creek Guide

items.t: The guide page is headed "Living in Morgan Creek, South Surrey: Local Area Guide," with guide sections (quick facts, schools, homes and lots, townhome complexes, golf, planning, before-you-buy, selling and FAQ) and the area's listing cards appended under "Additional Details"; it links out to the separate Morgan Creek homes-for-sale page. The guide page shows no total result count in the page text read; the cards appended at reading are the same two cards as the area page's feed sample — snapshot only. The exact feed filter criteria behind the guide page and any total count: UNVERIFIED.

Identity call: Morgan Creek is the established South Surrey golf-course community of larger lots and custom-built homes around 32 Avenue / 160 Street, centred on the Morgan Creek Golf Course, near White Rock Beach, Highway 99 and the U.S.

Morgan Heights is also a separate place — south of 28 Avenue and west of 164 Street, a newer neighbourhood planned in 2005 in Grandview Heights — and is not part of the Morgan Creek golf-course community.

Golf course, as the guide page states it: Morgan Creek Golf Course at 3500 Morgan Creek Way is a public course with a driving range and a golf academy, and it also runs Morgans Restaurant and Wine Bar and hosts weddings, tournaments and events.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Morgan Creek Guide

items.t: OCP — Surrey: Local plans for this ground: Rosemary Heights Central NCP, Rosemary Heights West NCP and Rosemary Heights Business Park Plan.
Zoning — Surrey: Surrey Zoning Bylaw, 1993, No. 12000 governs.

SSMUH — Surrey (adopted July 8, 2024): a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Added-unit permission is NOT permission to subdivide and does not create new lots.

Streamside / riparian (Surrey-wide frame, for any creek-side parcel): Surrey's streamside setbacks are defined in Part 7A of Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 and vary by stream class — the setback for a specific parcel is read off Part 7A and COSMOS; no single riparian figure is ever stated. The guide likewise advises reading title for covenants, rights of way and environmental setbacks on a golf-course or creekside lot before pricing what a lot can hold (site copy).

ALR block (parcel status UNCONFIRMED per parcel here — no ALR designation for Morgan Creek ground is documented in the research): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR, and no farm-class claim is asserted for this ground.

Strata block (bare-land strata parcels, where they exist): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw. A fee-simple lot carries none of this.

blocks.text: Good to know about Morgan Creek Guide

items.t: Expect a resale market, not a new-build one (City, via the guide research).
Do not merge the two lists.

Living here is not tied to golf (guide page). The course at 3500 Morgan Creek Way is public, as the guide page states it, so a buyer who never plays is buying the setting, not a membership obligation — confirm any course or club question with the course directly.

Morgan Heights is a third "Morgan" name (guide page). South of 28 Avenue and west of 164 Street, planned in 2005 in Grandview Heights — neither Morgan Creek nor Morgan Crossing. Listings using a bare "Morgan" name need the sub-area checked before any comparison is drawn.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Morgan Creek than in June?
faq.a: In Morgan Creek, listings of houses fell from 48 in June to 45 in September (−6.2%); condos and townhomes fell from 42 in June to 39 in September (−7.1%).

faq.q: How big is Morgan Creek compared with the rest of South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: In September 2026, Morgan Creek held 7.5% of the 600 houses listed in South Surrey and White Rock and 6.6% of the 593 condos and townhomes listed in South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Morgan Creek from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 15 houses and 27 condos and townhomes sold in Morgan Creek over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek the same as Morgan Crossing?
faq.a: No. Morgan Creek is the golf-course community around 32 Avenue / 160 Street with its own board row (Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; Condos & Townhomes 39 / 9 / 23% in September 2026); Morgan Crossing is the separate retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street in Grandview Heights, whose ground uses the Grandview board row.

faq.q: Is Rosemary Heights part of Morgan Creek?
faq.a: On MLS®, yes — the Morgan Creek sub-area includes both the golf course neighbourhood and Rosemary Heights, while the City treats Rosemary Heights as its own planning area with Central and West neighbourhood concept plans.

faq.q: What is Prescott Commons — is it a land offering?
How many units can a Morgan Creek lot hold under SSMUH?
faq.a: Up to 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop (Surrey changes adopted July 8, 2024).

faq.q: How big can a secondary suite be here?
faq.a: Its habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable floor area, one suite per dwelling unit, and it is not a separate strata lot.
